newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end flat, seen mixed.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end flat, seen mixed.

text.p: Pakistani stocks moved both ways before ending flat on Tuesday as players were uncertain over the direction of the market, dealers said.

They said the market was likely to remain mixed until the results of talks between Pakistani officials and the International Monetary Fund in Washington for the resumption of a stalled $600 million standby loan are known.
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index fell 0.80 point, or 0.06 percent, to end at 1,384.26. Losers led gainers 127 to 114. Turnover rose to 16.22 million shares from 11.35 million on Monday.
Askari Bank rose 1.15 rupees to 22.50 and Dewan Salman Fibre 1.45 to 24.20. Pakland Cement fell 0.50 to 13.50 and Hub Power Co 0.10 to 30.40.
Sui Northern Gas eased 1.0 to 36.25, PTCL 0.05 to 33.40 and Fauji Fertilizer 0.25 to 68.75.
